title: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming
label: Course 4
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.
outcome: A fourth course, built from Jose's group calls on one book about authority and personal brand, in the order of the calls. The book is not named yet. Modules are added one at a time.
season_note: A suggested run of about 20 weeks. Suggested dates only: nothing locks.

page_text: Each module is Jose's analysis of a book on a topic Jose teaches. Stand Up is not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors or publishers. The books are the authors' work; we recommend reading them. This is our own commentary, not a summary or replacement for the book. Education, not advice.
